note: Legal maximums and statutory rates for Turkish lira credit cards. Banks may charge less; a rate printed on the statement wins over this file, and a user override in settings wins over both. Amounts are in kuruş.

interest.basis: Monthly rate on the unpaid balance for the actual days from one cut-off date to the next, divided by 30 (TCMB/BDDK practice, see the bank example). Not compounded inside a cycle.

sets.verified: TCMB table, checked on the official page 2026-11-25: 3.25 / 3.75 / 4.25 % from 1/1/2026 to 30/11/2026. Earlier rows (Dec 2025: 3.50 / 4.00 / 4.50 % with 25.000 / 150.000 TL bands) are not in this file. Late interest = contractual + 0.30 points (TCMB Tebliğ 2020/16 art. 5).

TCMB table row 1/12/2026, checked on the official page 2026-11-25; tiers: debt under 30.000 TL, 30.000-180.000 TL, over 180.000 TL. Late interest = contractual + 0.30 points (TCMB Tebliğ 2020/16 art. 5).

taxes_on_interest.source: BSMV: Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı 7345, RG 07.07.2023, 32241 (rate on consumer credit interest 15 %). KKDF: Bakanlar Kurulu Kararı 2010/974, RG 28.10.2010, 27743 (15 %).
taxes_on_interest.verified: Rates checked on the official decisions 2026-11-25. Both texts say 'tüketici kredileri', not 'kredi kartı'; applying them to individual card interest follows bank practice, no official text says so explicitly. Override in settings if your statement shows otherwise.

sets.verified: BDDK Board Decision 11581 of 2026-10-01 (Yönetmelik art. 22/7), checked on bddk.org.tr 2026-11-25: 20 % up to 100.000 TL limit, 40 % above.

BDDK Board Decision 11605 of 2026-11-19 (Yönetmelik art. 22/7), checked on bddk.org.tr 2026-11-25: 20 / 30 / 40 % with 100.000 and 200.000 TL thresholds. The decision gives no start date; the decision date is used.

minimum_payment.note: The ratio applies to the statement total (dönem borcu); the tier is chosen by the card limit. A minimum printed on the statement wins for that statement.

due_date.holiday_rule: When the due date is a weekend day or public holiday, banks accept payment on the next business day without interest (common bank practice; check your card agreement).
due_date.source: Banka Kartları ve Kredi Kartları Hakkında Yönetmelik (RG 10.03.2007, 26458), https://www.mevzuat.gov.tr/

example_document: DenizBank public tariff 'Akdi ve Gecikme Faizi Hesaplama Örnekleri': 1.000 TL debt, 20% minimum paid, 800 TL unpaid at 1,98% for 10 + 20 days gives 5,28 + 10,56 = 15,84 TL interest (before BSMV and KKDF).
